name: "Energy-Replenishing Meal"
effect: Restores 16% of Max HP and an additional 1,350 HP to the selected character.
description: Mitya's specialty. The smoked sausage is richly savory without being overpowering, while the velvety mashed potatoes mellow out its richness and the vegetables round everything off with a touch of fresh sweetness. Every flavor seems calibrated to perfection, and with nutrition this well-balanced, it is practically a textbook-perfect lunch. According to Mitya, though, he merely "threw it together on the way here." Just how many times has he ducked out of work to get this good...? Then again, perhaps that's just Mitya for you.
